scope: All101 exported sessions: all11 without CTA plus detailed pre-CTA rrweb/event comparison across16 successes and74 CTA abandonments.
method: Decoded every rrweb record; inspected source3 scroll, source2 pointer/mouse interactions, source1 cursor positions and their DOM snapshot node IDs, source5 input presence. No visual playback; no user form values printed.

findings.observation: 10 normal no-CTA sessions spend30.85–48.23seconds; scroll into program/injury content at documentY3442–4295; no input events. One3.902second session clicks program/feature/injury cards at(0,0) with hit-test mismatches and is behaviorally distinct.
findings.causal_limit: Intent and whether the short session is manual QA cannot be established.

findings.observation: Every normal session contains negative-y rrweb clicks targeted at html. Action log clamps these coordinates to the top viewport edge.293 negative clicks across100 sessions reconstruct to documentY1400(96),1480(102),1482(95).
findings.causal_limit: This is repeated scripted behavior, not evidence of rage clicking or attempts to select visible text; intended DOM target remains unknown.

projection_check.method: Parent rendered local e03 preview at1280x720, set scrollY1000, queried elementFromPoint with document_y minus scrollY.
projection_check.document_y_1480_1482: P: Больше половины времени посвящено тренировкам...
projection_check.interpretation: Fixed coordinates correspond to first feature card in this static projection. Actual rrweb click target is html at negative viewportY after scrolling to injury content; no intended target or human intent is proven.

findings.observation: Success pre-CTA median42.11seconds vs abandonment46.75seconds; both have3 preceding selection_attempt events and scroll to around6400px before hero CTA.
findings.causal_limit: The hero CTA is not clicked early in the observed scripted journey. Similar paths do not identify the reason for submission choice.

findings.observation: 11 no-CTA exits include the3.9second outlier; even rescuing all11 while holding other outcomes fixed yields27/101, below50%.
findings.implication: Primary optimization must target the74 CTA abandonments as well.

tracker_defect.mechanism: point() clamps negative clientY to0. pointerdown stores clamped start.point; pointerup compares raw clientY to clamped start.point.y, manufacturing drag distance above8px even at identical raw down/up position. This produces collapsed selection_attempt records lasting0–2ms.
tracker_defect.compatible_fix: Keep raw start clientX/clientY internally for distance calculation, preserve existing bounded event payload. Optionally add explicitly versioned raw_client_x/raw_client_y and in_viewport fields after coordinating server validation/schema. Do not silently reinterpret historical clamped coordinates.
tracker_defect.conversion_impact: No evidence that fixing tracking semantics changes simulator conversions; it improves interpretation only.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Long narrative program contributes friction before the decision to fill the form.
hypotheses.evidence: All normal sessions traverse deep content; successful and unsuccessful pre-CTA journeys differ little. Early exits cluster around program/injury depth.
hypotheses.proposed_test: Shorten each existing program-module paragraph and intro, retaining module order/classes and factual course coverage. Keep form, price and CTA behavior unchanged.
hypotheses.prediction: Lower pre-CTA dwell/page height and higher confirmed submissions among CTA sessions; declare failure if only depth/timing changes without conversion lift.
hypotheses.confidence: Low to moderate; observational signals do not establish intent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The site does not make the next registration step and commitment sufficiently clear at the form.
hypotheses.evidence: 74 CTA sessions fail after reaching the form; early-stage behavior is very similar to successes.
hypotheses.proposed_test: After counterpart abandonment analysis, test concise truthful next-step/price clarification inside registration section without removing required fields or inventing no-payment guarantees.
hypotheses.prediction: More actual input events and subsequent-field focus after CTA; conversion lift rather than only automatic name focus.
hypotheses.confidence: Low; no direct evidence of concern about commitment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Early CTA alone does not bypass content friction under the observed simulator behavior.
hypotheses.evidence: 90 CTA sessions click hero source only after traversing deep content; max pre-CTA scroll success median6411px, abandonment6344.5px.
hypotheses.proposed_test: Treat e03 result as a change package rather than proof of early-use mechanism; prioritize experiments on content hierarchy while preserving controls.
hypotheses.prediction: Do not expect additional repeated hero CTAs alone to eliminate pre-CTA scripted browsing.
hypotheses.confidence: High regarding observed timing, low regarding simulator internals.

limitations: The exported session count101 differs from simulator100; behavioral outlier cannot be conclusively attributed.
No simulator source or intent inferred.
rrweb metadata clock differs slightly from action at_ms; exact cross-stream durations need explicit clock alignment.
Snapshot/event analysis is not visual replay.
